title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - SingleLevelBomAsBuilt
description:
The single-level bill of material represents one sub-level of an assembly and does not include any lower-level subassemblies. The as-built lifecycle references all child items as manufactured by the manufacturer referencing only child items in an as-built lifecycle themselves (e.g. serial parts or batches), unless parts can only be tracked by an part ID (on a type level).

If it is unclear which item has been built-in into the parent item, all potential parts must be listed. This is the case when, e.g. the same item is supplied by two suppliers and the item is only tracked by a customer part ID during assembly, these items can not be differentiated from each other. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_bom_as_built:4.0.0#SingleLevelBomAsBuilt, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SingleLevelBomAsBuilt'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

childItems.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_bom_as_built:4.0.0#childItems'. Set of child items, of which the given parent item was assembled by (one structural level down).

items.description: Catena-X ID and meta data of the assembled child item.

quantity.description: Quantity of which the child item is assembled into the parent item. In general it is '1' for serialized parts.

value.description: The quantity value associated with the unit.

unit.description: The unit of an item. Common units may be related to mass, count, linear, area, volume or misc.

hasAlternatives.description:
Expresses whether the part is built-in or wether it is one of several options. If the value is false, it can be assumed this exact item is built-in. If the value is true, it is unknown wether this or an alternative item is built-in.
This is the case when, e.g. the same item is supplied by two suppliers, the item is only tracked by a customer part ID during assembly. Thus, these items can not be differentiated from each other.

lastModifiedOn.description: Timestamp when the assembly or usage relationship between parent part and child part was last modified.

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the relation between the parent part and the child part was created

globalAssetId.description: The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.

businessPartner.description: The supplier of the given child item.

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
